Trace the beam using \(45^\circ\) reflections:

1. Enters horizontally from the left and hits the first upper mirror \(\backslash\), so it turns downward.
2. Hits the first lower mirror \(\backslash\), turning right.
3. Hits the second lower mirror \(/\), turning upward.
4. Hits the second upper mirror \(/\), turning right.
5. Hits the third upper mirror \(\backslash\), turning downward.
6. Hits the third lower mirror \(\backslash\), turning right.
7. Hits the fourth lower mirror \(/\), turning upward.
8. Hits the fourth upper mirror \(/\), turning right.

The beam then exits the rectangle on the right side at the height corresponding to letter \(E\).
